blocks.text: Bigger worlds hold more pops and get more building lots.
Size is a world's pop cap and sets its crust and spice reserve.
The best farmland and almost no spice: a breadbasket for your pops.
blocks.title: Terran

blocks.text: Good farmland, thin crust, and the richest spice of any world. Build Spice Extractors here.
blocks.title: Desert

blocks.text: Middling food, a little spice, but the deepest crust and faster Mines: a mining world.
blocks.title: Arctic

blocks.text: Barely grows food, but its Power Plants make extra energy: an energy world.
blocks.title: Molten

blocks.text: Can't be settled. Gas Skimmers mine its minerals; drained, it explodes.
blocks.title: Gas Giant

blocks.text: Little food but plenty of spice. Moons orbit gas giants.
blocks.title: Barren Moon
